meta.metric: strict pair-level micro F1 unless explicitly stated
meta.principle: model identity, split, scorer and hardware protocol must match within each comparison; mock and smoke data are forbidden

r2d_tr1_ensemble.label: r2d_tr1 two-seed ensemble (legacy TR1)
r2d_tr1_ensemble.clean_scope_note: Legacy TR1 has exact-sequence overlap with TS0 and ArchiveII; among the three measured cells, only bpRNA-new is exact-overlap clean. Thus 2/3 is an arithmetic reference comparison, not a clean-SOTA claim.
r2d_tr1_ensemble.bpRNA_new_note: 0.6132 exceeds the selected UFold reference 0.6106, but is below EternaFold 0.6854, MXfold2 0.6688 and eFold 0.6640; it is not full-board SOTA.

rnaformer_original_report.source: Franke et al., RNAformer bioRxiv 2024, Tables 2 and 4; TS0 workshop value is from arXiv:2307.10073 Table 1
rnaformer_original_report.biophysical_scope: Rfam synthetic RNAfold-distillation test, not a PDB benchmark reference
rnaformer_original_report.protocol_note: Original reported F1 includes pseudoknots and non-canonical pairs; project matched-GT scores use canonical nested pairs. Original values are shown for discussion but are not substituted into SOTA counts.

main_benchmark.correction: The historical 7/8 summary substitutes r2d_tr1 two-seed ensemble 0.6132 for xens2 0.5532 on bpRNA-new; it is not a uniform xens2 result.
main_benchmark.testsetb_note: xens2 is 0.8370 on clean-181 and 0.8448 on full-428; single r2d is 0.7167 on clean-181 and 0.7507 on full-428; the clean reference RiNALMo-ft is 0.8177.

leakage_audit.note: Exact normalized-sequence overlap; this is not an identity- or homology-level guarantee. Clean references are chosen per split.

speed.note: All ladder points use r2dtr1c-s0 on TS0; predictions and F1 are unchanged across batch size.

accuracy_speed_a100.note: The frontier is computed only within the A100 end-to-end TS0 board. The RTX 4090 point is shown separately and is not mixed into the A100 frontier.

ece.note: Structure-level ECE, 10-bin weighted absolute confidence-versus-F1 gap; VL0 affine parameters a=1.6 and b=-1.9 are frozen for every test split.

ncrna.protocol: project 177-class sensitivity line; not the original RiNALMo 88-class result

downstream.note: Frozen RiNALMo backbone; only the downstream head changes. Splice remains archived and is not shown in the main figure.

comparison.test: paired t-test across five pre-registered seeds; Holm correction across three datasets
paired t-test across five pre-registered seeds; Holm correction across three datasets
paired t-test across five pre-registered seeds; Holm correction across three datasets

ncrna_177_sensitivity.protocol: project 177-class sensitivity line; not the original RiNALMo 88-class result

additional_mrl_round32.protocol: 30/30 CUDA early-stopping runs; all three are retained and none is relabelled as significant

chanrg.note: OFoldNA Table 3 length-controlled protocol, 50-200 nt, pseudoknots excluded. OOD mean is the unweighted mean of GenA, GenC and GenF.

matched_30k_current.note: All six arms are complete and independently verified; three-seed statistics and preregistered verdicts are included.

verdicts.note: Gates are evaluated on three-seed means; paired per-sequence Wilcoxon-Holm remains mandatory for interpretation.

ablation_round33.source: main_ablation_5x8.json; direct control-minus-ablation and negated delta_from_control agree within 1e-12

accuracy_speed_4090_round33.scope: raw sequence -> tokenization -> encoder -> task head -> required decode; cached_embeddings=false
accuracy_speed_4090_round33.note: All listed values are medians of three complete TS0 runs with invariant predictions. UFold/RNAformer/MXfold2 remain pending and are not backfilled from A100 values.

cpeb3_fitness.protocol: frozen NucleicBERT CLS; official fitness-head architecture versus JEV head with the same MSE probe objective; original full fine-tuning is reference-only

nb_original_tasks_round33.note: Full-dataset result with independent saved-output QA; no smoke values are included. Negative and nonsignificant results are retained.

ncrna88.status: official_data_gate_pass; clean and bn200 full dual-head results pass independent GPU QA
ncrna88.boundary_noise: clean and bn200; original sequence preserved with official boundary extension
ncrna88.strengthened_bn200_card_validation: PASS; full original-insertion and flank-composition validation; validate-only uses Rscript for version metadata

rinalmo_original_data_round33.inference_scope: paired training-seed effects; no test-set population inference
